notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – Maze Update
notes.content:
[p]We’ve made several improvements to the maze section of the game to enhance clarity and improve the overall player experience. Thanks for your feedback!

💡 [b]Hint System Update

[/b]Enhanced in-game hints with more relevant guidance.

⚙️ [b]Accessibility & Ease of Use[/b][/p][p]Simplified maze navigation flow to reduce player confusion.[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Demo Update – Performance Improvements! 🚀
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just pushed an update to the [b]SQUAWKY[/b] demo, and we’ve made a few important changes based on your feedback:[/p][p]🛠 [b]Performance Fixes[/b]
We’ve resolved several performance-related issues that were affecting gameplay stability and framerate. The game should now run smoother across a wider range of hardware.[/p][p]⚙️ [b]Updated Default Graphics Settings[/b]
To help the game run better on lower-end PCs, we’ve adjusted the default graphical settings to be more performance-friendly. You can still tweak everything manually in the settings menu to match your preferences.[/p][p]Thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback, it helps a ton! Keep it coming, and stay tuned for more updates.[/p][p]— Spark Labs Gaming Team [/p]
